description: Rug check and due-diligence snapshot of an ERC-20 token on Polygon PoS: a 0-100 risk score with reasons, name, symbol, decimals, supply, owner and whether ownership is renounced, upgradeable-proxy detection, owner-only functions found in the bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist, fee changes), and USD price, liquidity and FDV from the deepest WPOL or USDC pool on Uniswap v3.
